claim: The record has no answer for a second non-conciliation record on the same dispute. The Supreme Court's social chamber holds that the six months of CPCA 504 run from the FIRST record, that a second record on the same dispute cannot be obtained and does not revive the right, and that the resulting inadmissibility is of public order. In the decided case the worker's first claim was declared inadmissible in form, a second claim was forfeited, and a third claim on a second record was quashed without remand.

source.what: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1488919, decision of 07-10-2021, subject «صلح», legal reference CPCA art. 504 (reasoning also cites art. 69). Facts as published: first record 09-10-2017, first claim 25-03-2018 inadmissible in form (12-07-2018), second claim 31-07-2018 declared forfeited (04-10-2018), second record 30-04-2019 used for the claim under review. Quashed without remand.

quoteArabic: يسقط حق العامل في رفع دعواه أمام القسم الاجتماعي، إذا أصبح محضر عدم الصلح الأول خارج أجل ستة أشهر. لا يمكن استصدار محضر ثان بعدم الصلح بخصوص نفس النزاع الذي تضمنه المحضر الأول.
consequence: Build the case: first record delivered 2025-01-10, nothing filed; the worker goes back to the inspectorate and gets a second record delivered 2026-03-02; petition 2026-05-04. The lawyer enters 2026-03-02 as nonconciliation_record_delivered_on, so d1 finds nothing, p1 is done, and the export is clean, although by this decision the claim is forfeited and the judge must raise it. The record should ask whether an earlier non-conciliation record exists for the same dispute, count d1 from the earliest one, and treat a later record as not reopening the period. A claim declared inadmissible in form does not stop the clock either (same facts).

claim: The record leaves open whether the judge raises the CPCA 504 forfeiture of his own motion (d1/d2 raisedBy "unclear", o2 grade C). The Supreme Court's social chamber answers it: the inadmissibility for a claim outside the six months is of public order and the judge raises it of his own motion under CPCA 69.

source.what: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1488919, decision of 07-10-2021 (CPCA arts. 504 and 69). The reasoning also states that art. 504 carries the sanction of forfeiture and inadmissibility.

quoteArabic: ويعد عدم قبول الدعوى في هذه الحالة من النظام العام يثيره القاضي تلقائيا طبقا للمادة 69 من ق إ م إ.
consequence: o2 is not open at the level of the Supreme Court's published case law: d1 and d2 should say the court raises the forfeiture of its own motion (raisedBy: court), and d2's force-majeure path should not suggest the period is only enforced on the opponent's plea. The protective reading already treats the period as binding, so blockCleanExport is consistent; what is wrong is the open point and the 'unclear' label shown to the lawyer.

claim: The record says no text states the sanction of a claim filed without a non-conciliation record, keeps a 'curable defect' reading open (o1), and only warns. The Supreme Court's social chamber states as a principle that the claim is not admissible before the social section without a non-conciliation record, and it raised the point of its own motion as a breach of a fundamental procedural rule, quashing without remand; a second decision (file 1340230) again raised arts. 19, 36 and 37 of Law 90-04 of its own motion and quashed without remand.

source.what: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1158046, decision of 07-09-2017 (Law 90-04 arts. 33-34, CPCA art. 504), quashed without remand, quashing extended to the judgments of 17-06-2012 and 27-05-2015. See also file 1340230, decision of 05-03-2020, social chamber: https://coursupreme.dz/decision/%d9%85%d9%84%d9%81-%d8%b1%d9%82%d9%85-1340230-%d9%82%d8%b1%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d8%a8%d8%aa%d8%a7%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%ae-2020-03-05/ (ground raised of the Court's own motion under CPCA 358, relying on Law 90-04 arts. 19, 36, 37; quashed without remand under CPCA 365).

quoteArabic: لا تقبل الدعوى أمام القسم الإجتماعي في غياب محضر عدم مصالحة. … عن الوجه التلقائي : المأخوذ من مخالفة قاعدة جوهرية في الإجراءات.
consequence: o1's second reading (a defect cured by producing the record later) and k27's 'no text classes the step as public order; open' are contradicted by the court's published principle. Outside the exemptions, a missing non-conciliation record makes the claim inadmissible, raised by the court itself. p1's warning should say so in terms (inadmissibility, raised of the court's own motion, quashing without remand), and whether p1 'warn' is still the right effect next to d1's block needs a decision; n5 and o10 (record delivered on or after filing) follow the same principle.

claim: Where a conciliation agreement was recorded, the Supreme Court treats an ordinary claim before the social section on that agreement as contrary to CPCA 504 and quashes without remand, and holds that requests not covered by the agreement are not admissible in the enforcement route. The record's n1 only says the case is 'outside' and that the lawyer should check what the agreement covered; it does not handle the common mixed petition (enforce the agreement and add other wage heads).

source.what: Supreme Court, social chamber, file 1340230, decision of 05-03-2020 (Law 90-04 art. 34): the worker sued on a conciliation record of 11-04-2017 and added bonuses, productivity pay, wages and documents not covered by it; the first-instance judge ruled on the merits; quashed without remand. Also file 1158046 of 07-09-2017 (claim founded on a conciliation record held contrary to CPCA 504).

quoteArabic: ينفذ اتفاق المصالحة بموجب أمر من رئيس المحكمة عن طريق الالتماس بعريضة من أجل التنفيذ في أول جلسة. لا تقبل الطلبات الجديدة التي لم تكن محل اتفاق المصالحة.
consequence: Build the case: agreement recorded on part of the wages, the employer pays nothing, the worker files one statement of claim asking for execution of the agreement plus the other unpaid months. The record (n1 warns, p1 none when a record also exists as in rex12) lets it through as a claim. It should say that a merits claim on a conciliation agreement is inadmissible, that the agreement goes to the president by petition, and that heads not covered by the agreement need their own non-conciliation record (this answers o7 and k41 in part). CPCA 510 (b35) admits additional requests only in a claim properly brought on a non-conciliation record; it does not rescue new heads in the enforcement route.

target: doc1, p1, aex7, aex8, bex5, bex9, rex11
claim: doc1 makes the copy of the non-conciliation record required whenever the worker is not a civil servant, including when 19 ¶2 made conciliation optional (defendant abroad, bankruptcy or judicial settlement) and no conciliation took place. Article 37 requires the copy only of a record 'issued by the conciliation office as set out in articles 26 to 32'; when the optional step was skipped no such record exists.

source.what: Law 90-04 of 6 February 1990, art. 19 ¶2 (Official Journal 1990, issue 6, 7 February 1990, p. 242) and art. 37 (same law; store text labelled law-90-04).

quoteArabic: يعتبر اجراء المصالحة المنصوص عليه في الفقرة السابقة اختياريا … ترفق العريضة الموجهة إلى المحكمة بنسخة من محضر عدم المصالحة الصادر عن مكتب المصالحة كما هو مبين في المواد من 26 إلى 32 من هذا القانون.
consequence: In aex7/bex5/rex11 (defendant abroad, no record) p1 correctly says nothing, yet doc1 still lists a document that cannot exist as required. doc1.requiredWhen should also exclude the 19 ¶2 cases when no conciliation was attempted (and ask the lawyer to show the exemption instead).

claim: The record's quote of art. 19 ¶2 reads «عندما يقيم المدعى عليه خارج التراب الوطني», sourced tier 1. The Arabic Official Journal page prints «عندما يقدم المدعي عليه خارج التراب الوطني». The quoted wording, and its hash, are therefore not the published Arabic text; the meaning 'resides' is very likely right but rests on a correction (or on the French text) that the record does not state.

source.what: Law 90-04 of 6 February 1990, art. 19 ¶2, Official Journal 1990, issue 6 (7 February 1990), p. 242, left column. The French text of the same issue was not fetched.

quoteArabic: يعتبر اجراء المصالحة المنصوص عليه في الفقرة السابقة اختياريا عندما يقدم المدعي عليه خارج التراب الوطني أو حالة الافلاس أو تسوية قضائية من قبل صاحب العمل.
consequence: Record that the published Arabic text prints «يقدم», and confirm «يقيم / réside» against the French Official Journal before treating the 'defendant resides abroad' exemption as text-verified. The same page also prints «يقبل مرتبه» in art. 25 (b46) where «يقل» is meant; the store copies that misprint.

claim: r1 and b40 carry only the provisional execution by law for wages of the last six months (art. 22 ¶4). The next paragraph of the same article lets the court order provisional execution without bond for the period beyond six months, which is the usual request in an unpaid-wages claim covering more than six months.

source.what: Law 90-04 of 6 February 1990, art. 22 last paragraph (store: labour-disputes 22 ¶5), Official Journal 1990, issue 6, p. 243, right column.

quoteArabic: كما يمكن المحكمة عند النظر في المسائل الاجتماعية ان تنطق بالتنفيذ المؤقت دون كفالة فيما بعد ستة اشهر.
consequence: For appliesTo unpaid-wages, add the optional request (provisional execution without bond for wages beyond the last six months, at the court's discretion), distinct from r1's execution by law; k59's note 'by operation of law for the matters listed in article 22' misses this discretionary limb.

claim: The checklist notes oppose individual disputes to collective disputes 'governed by Law 90-02'. Law 90-02 is said to have been repealed and replaced by Law 23-08 of 2023 on the prevention and settlement of collective labour disputes and the exercise of the right to strike. Not checked on joradp.dz in this run.

source.what: Own memory: Law 23-08 (June 2023) on collective labour disputes and the right to strike, said to repeal Law 90-02 of 6 February 1990. Lead only.

consequence: Boundary n3 rests on Law 90-04 art. 2 and stays right; only the notes naming Law 90-02 as the governing text should be checked and, if the lead is confirmed, name Law 23-08.
